basis: The printing heads this gloss 'VERS. 12.' and it opens 'Vers. 12. Cumque sol occumberet. Solis occubitus | finem saeculi significat, quando per'. The chapter is Migne's caput, carried from the last one the printing states, and the lemma raises nothing against it.
date_basis: Remigius taught at Reims and then at Paris and died about 908. His scriptural commentaries are products of that teaching and are not separately dated; the range covers the years in which he taught. The date is the writing, not Migne's 1853 printing.
text: Vers. 12. Cumque sol occumberet. Solis occubitus | finem saeculi significat, quando per Antichristum tenebrosus horror, id est persecutio vel perturbatio futura est.
